title: SYSTEM: стабильный системный промпт
priority_rule: Design requested now; implementation not yet requested. Existing VIBE-NEEDS wins among equally architecture-ready implementation tasks.
qualification: New owner-requested feature, not evidence of prototype implementation or accepted product behavior. Stable prefix is paired with checked live boot suffix.

nodes.title: Роли входов, граница стабильного префикса и живого контекста
nodes.contract: SYSTEM-TEMPLATE — authored input; SYSTEM — generated output; selected-node central scope, no quiet-worker reuse; file identity is not provider cache identity.

nodes.title: Проверенный снимок загрузки и зависимостей промпта
nodes.contract: Use existing retained inputs and exact byte witnesses; no home-state expansion or prose-link recursion; classify INDEX separately from static-link lane.

nodes.title: Детерминированная сборка SYSTEM и плана продолжения
nodes.contract: Literal template + exact entrypoint export + static lane; runtime INDEX plan preserves original order/conditions; no second compiler.

nodes.title: Согласованная публикация и обнаружение устаревшего SYSTEM
nodes.contract: Publish prompt/metadata through existing boot transaction; reject self-inclusion, conflicting authored outputs and changed inputs; no unchanged-byte rewrite.

nodes.title: Генерация при install/reinstall и проверяемая подготовка API-сессии
nodes.contract: Opt-in convention, read-only check/prepare, explicit regeneration; complete boot = checked prefix plus fresh runtime suffix.

nodes.title: Использование в API и диагностика попаданий в кэш
nodes.contract: Explicit supported request role/tool ordering/profile; actual provider usage metrics; no universal hit/TTL/savings guarantee.

nodes.title: Сценарии совместимости, свежести и повторяемости
nodes.contract: Differential boot parity, format/OS/member/worker matrix, no recursive growth, stale refusal, privacy sentinels and exact request capture; live-cache experiments separately authorized.

nodes.title: Примеры шаблона и руководство по стоимости/миграции
nodes.contract: Describe new authored/generated files, limitations, invalidation inputs and measured cost; no claims of implemented feature from specification.
